The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions.
RSI has exited oversold territory and settled in the neutral zone, but the MACD histogram shows improvement, yet it's not at a level to confirm a trend reversal.
Volume ratio at 0.85 indicates a subdued state, suggesting a phase of directional exploration.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (26.6→35.1): 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착, 상승 모멘텀 약함.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0009→0.0012): 개선 중이나 여전히 음수 구간, 추세 전환 신호 미약.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $0.16): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 33.13%로 변동성 보통.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.15): 현재가와 일치, 심리적 지지선.
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.18): 돌파 시 단기 상승 전환 가능성.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 방향성 부재.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.85): 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임의 신뢰도 하락.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착, MACD 개선 미미. 방향성 탐색 구간으로 관망 유지 조건.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($0.15) vs SMA5($0.15)/SMA20($0.16)/SMA50($0.19): Trading near the middle band, below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100($0.21)/SMA200($0.20): Below long-term trends, indicating bearish strength.
· 52-week Position (4.4%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (26.6→35.1): Exited oversold, settled in neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0009→0.0012): Improving but still in negative territory, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $0.16): Trading near the middle band, 33.13% band width indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.15): Aligns with current price, psychological support level.
· Swing Resistance ($0.18): Potential for short-term upward trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): Lack of directional bias.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.85): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI exited oversold and settled in neutral zone, MACD shows slight improvement. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach in a directional exploration phase.
